Roulette Overview

Token spins and reward pools

Roulette systems use tokens to roll reward pools. Update notes confirm Deluxe Roulette and Lite Roulette tokens can be used for 10x roulette, and donation notes list cosmetic, coin, token, and Living Token reward possibilities.

03

Roulette Notes

Confirmed roulette behavior
  • Deluxe Roulette Tokens and Lite Roulette Tokens can be used to roulette 10x at once.
  • Some launch-period notes remove specific items from reward pools during the first 7 days.
  • Roulette reward notes include cosmetics, coins, Cosmetic Tokens, Promotion Tokens, and Living Tokens as possible reward themes.
